# RoyaleGym

> Train Clash Royale bots with reinforcement learning, in Python. Five packages, split the way
> RLGym splits Rocket League: RoyaleSim (the battle engine, Rust with Python bindings; RocketSim's
> role), RoyaleGym (the environment, built from configuration objects with RLGym v2's names:
> StateMutator, ObsBuilder, ActionParser, RewardFunction, termination and truncation
> DoneConditions), RoyaleLearn (the PPO trainer; RLGym-PPO's role), RoyaleViser (the viewer;
> RLViser's role) and RoyaleImitate (warm start from a trained bot, and a penalty that keeps a
> new bot near it). Install everything with `pip install "royalegym[all]"` (Python 3.12+); on
> Windows install CUDA PyTorch first. Training assumes an NVIDIA GPU. The engine's battle logic
> is still being matched to the real game; the Python APIs are meant to stay put.

Each repository also has an AGENTS.md at its root with its layout, build and test commands, and
the rules its tests enforce.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](index.md): what the five packages are, installation and the extras
- [Overview](overview.md): the configuration objects, the two seats, what happens in one step
- [Quick Start Guide](quickstart.md): one file, build_env() plus Learner(...), that trains a bot

## Clash Royale

- [Training an Agent](clash-royale/training-an-agent.md): custom rewards, every trainer setting, self-play, decks, watching, wandb
- [Action Parsers](clash-royale/configuration-objects/action-parsers.md): the 2305 moves, the action mask, ability buttons, writing one
- [Done Conditions](clash-royale/configuration-objects/done-conditions.md): termination vs truncation, the shipped ones, writing one
- [Observation Builders](clash-royale/configuration-objects/observation-builders.md): the spatial observation, fair information, writing one
- [Opponents](clash-royale/configuration-objects/opponents.md): scripted bots, evaluate(), ClashGymEnv
- [Reward Functions](clash-royale/configuration-objects/reward-functions.md): the shipped rewards, CombinedReward, writing one
- [State Mutators](clash-royale/configuration-objects/state-mutators.md): decks by name, evolutions and heroes, mid-game starts, writing one
- [Viewer](clash-royale/configuration-objects/viewer.md): watch training live, save and open a battle, keys
